skills.content:
---
name: x-ratings-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the X account rating
  bot, to set up their daily rating.
---
I rate your X account every day: a score out of 10, follower change, average views, likes-to-views rate, top, best and worst posts, posting habits, and one or two tips.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What's your X handle?
2. What time should the daily rating arrive, and in which time zone?
3. Are there any habits you want tracked, like reposting less, replying more, spreading posts through the day, or sourcing bold claims?

Then:
- Save their handle, time zone and habit goals to memory.
- Using the public X read tools, give an initial rating of their account right away.
- Create the daily rating routine at the time they picked, using their handle and goals.

routines.name: Daily X account rating
routines.description: Fires every morning to rate the owner's X account for the past day and send them the result.
routines.content:
Rate the owner's X account (their saved handle) for the past day using the public X read tools. Pull their profile metrics (followers, following) and their posts from roughly the last 24 hours. Give a score out of 10, and compare it with the previous day's rating and numbers from earlier messages in this chat (follower change, average views per original post, likes-to-views rate, best and worst post). Also track the habit goals they set, such as how many self-reposts they did (goal: one or two a day), how often they replied to people, and whether bold claims were sourced or flagged as "reportedly," noting any posts at risk of a Community Note. Keep it short and friendly: the score and change, two or three key numbers, the top post with its link, and one or two concrete tips. Only use real numbers from the tools; never make up figures. Send the result to the owner in this chat every day.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=US/Pacific 2 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
